title: Sigma GeneElute Total RNA Extraction from Fungal Tissue
author: ALEXANDER J BRADSHAW
materials: Flash Freeze tissue in Liquid Nitrogen (LN2).
immediately store samples at -80C after loading gel.

steps.title: Grind Fungal Tissue
steps.instruction: Grind fungal tissue to a fine powder using a mortar and pestle with liquid nitrogen (LN2), ensuring the tissue does not thaw during the process.

steps.title: Prepare Sample for Extraction
steps.instruction: Combine ground tissue and buffer RL in a 1.7ml Eppendorf tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 600ul of buffer RL to a 1.7ml Eppendorf tube.
Place no more than 50mg of ground tissue into the tube with buffer RL.

steps.title: Lysis and Clarification
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample and centrifuge to separate the lysate.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 15-30 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge at maximum speed for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare Lysate for Binding
steps.instruction: Transfer the lysate and mix with ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the lysate to a new RNAse-free 1.7ml tube.
Add a 1:1 volume (600ul) of freshly prepared 70% ethanol.
Vortex for 10 seconds or until homogenous.

steps.title: RNA Binding
steps.instruction: Pass the lysate/ethanol solution through a GeneElute column.

substeps.instruction: Assemble a column with a waste tube from the GeneElute kit.
Add 600ul of lysate/etoh solution to the assembled column.
Centrifuge at 6000G for 2 minutes.
If lysate has not completely passed, spin at an additional 14,000G for 1 minute.
Discard waste from the waste tube and repeat the loading and centrifugation steps if more lysate/etoh remains.

steps.title: Wash RNA Column
steps.instruction: Wash the column three times to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Place the column into a new waste collection tube.
Add 400ul of wash solution A to the column.
Centrifuge at max speed for 1.5 minutes.
Repeat the addition of wash solution A and centrifugation two more times (for a total of 3x wash steps).

steps.title: Dry Column
steps.instruction: Perform a final dry spin to remove residual wash buffer.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample for a final 2-minute dry spin at max speed.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the RNA into a clean collection tube.

substeps.instruction: Place the column in a clean Eppendorf tube provided in the GeneElute kit.
Add 50ul of elution solution A.
Centrifuge at 200G for 2 minutes.
Centrifuge at 14,000G for 1 minute.
If the entire 50ul has not eluted, spin for an additional minute at 14,000G.

steps.title: Prepare for RNA Analysis
steps.instruction: Store eluted samples on ice and prepare a bleach gel for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Keep eluted samples on ice.
Prepare a bleach gel using 100ml TAE, 400ul concentrated bleach, and 1g agarose (add bleach before microwaving).

steps.title: Run RNA Analysis
steps.instruction: Load and run the samples on the bleach gel.

substeps.instruction: Load samples with a 100bp ladder.
Run at 120V for approximately 20 minutes.
